name: Solgrip Yuzu-Ginger Pulls
description: Long-pull synth-taffy in yuzu-ginger flavor, individually wrapped in wax-paper printed with low-res geometric art. Solgrip's yuzu-ginger variant is the workday staple of the line — less aggressive than their chili pulls, more complex than anything the big corps bother making at this price.
flavor_profile: Bright citrus snap of yuzu upfront, warming ginger middle, faint salt finish that makes the sweetness linger
cultural_context: the Gray Zone workers tuck these in jacket pockets for long shifts. The act of slowly pulling the candy apart is considered mildly stress-relieving — therapists in Tier 2 clinics actually recommend them as a tactile focus tool. Counterfeit Solgrip wraps exist; regulars can tell by the texture.
story_hooks: A runner uses torn Solgrip wax-paper wrappers as improvised trail markers through a flooded the Gray Zone corridor — someone is following the trail back.
A Tier 2 clinic therapist has been quietly lacing their recommended candy supply with unlicensed mood compounds; the Solgrip distributor has no idea.
The geometric art on each wrapper is a rotating cipher — someone has been encoding short messages in the print run for six months.
